topics.name: Python Programming Fundamentals
topics.description: Foundational introduction to Python programming, including the Python programming language, basic program structure, and execution.

topics.name: Variables
topics.description: The use of variables in Python to hold and work with values during program execution.

topics.name: Input
topics.description: Obtaining input from the user using Python's input functionality.

topics.name: Operators & Expressions
topics.description: Python operators and expressions used to perform computations and construct values from operands.

topics.name: Operator Precedence & Associativity
topics.description: Rules that determine the order in which operators in Python expressions are evaluated.

topics.name: Selection Statements
topics.description: Python control structures used to select which statements execute based on conditions.

topics.name: Looping Statements
topics.description: Python control structures used to repeatedly execute statements according to iteration conditions.

topics.name: Lists
topics.description: Python list data structures and their fundamental operations for storing and manipulating ordered collections of values.

topics.name: Tuples
topics.description: Python tuple data structures and their operations for representing ordered collections of values.

topics.name: Dictionaries
topics.description: Python dictionary data structures and their operations for storing and accessing key-value pairs.

topics.name: Sets
topics.description: Python set data structures and their operations for representing collections of unique values.

topics.name: Strings
topics.description: Python strings, their types, and operations for representing and manipulating textual data.

topics.name: File Operations
topics.description: Working with files in Python, including file handling and operations on stored data.

topics.name: Functions
topics.description: Defining and calling reusable functions in Python to organize and execute computational tasks.

topics.name: Function Parameters
topics.description: Using positional and keyword parameters when defining and calling Python functions.

topics.name: Variable-Length Arguments
topics.description: Using variable-length positional arguments and key-value arguments when defining Python functions.

topics.name: Recursion
topics.description: A programming technique in which a function calls itself to solve a problem through smaller instances of the same problem.

topics.name: Callbacks
topics.description: Using functions as callbacks so that one function can receive and invoke another function as part of its execution.

topics.name: Generators
topics.description: Python generators for producing values iteratively rather than computing and storing all values at once.

topics.name: Closures
topics.description: Functions that retain access to variables from their enclosing scope after that enclosing context has completed.

topics.name: Decorators
topics.description: Python constructs used to modify or extend the behavior of functions or other callable objects without directly changing their implementation.

topics.name: Lambda Functions
topics.description: Anonymous functions defined using Python's lambda expression syntax for concise functional operations.

topics.name: Map, Filter & Reduce
topics.description: Functional programming operations in Python for transforming, selecting, and aggregating elements of iterable data.

topics.name: Classes & Objects
topics.description: Defining classes and creating objects in Python to represent data and behavior using object-oriented programming.

topics.name: Inheritance & Polymorphism
topics.description: Object-oriented programming concepts for deriving classes from existing classes and allowing related objects to be used through common interfaces.

topics.name: Iterators
topics.description: Python iteration mechanisms that provide sequential access to elements of an iterable.
